summary.text: Michelle Badger is a Democratic state representative from the 1st Plymouth District who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Plymouth School Committee member, she works in higher education administration.

paragraphs.text: Michelle Badger graduated from Plymouth South High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Sweet Briar College in 2006, and earned a graduate degree from Suffolk University in 2010.
Her career experience includes working in higher education administration, and her prior office was the Plymouth School Committee.
Badger assumed office on January 1, 2025, succeeding Republican Mathew Muratore.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the House Committee on Federal Funding, Policy and Accountability and to the Higher Education, Emergency Preparedness and Management, and Housing joint committees.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
